verdict.rationale: Docs show versioned endpoints (e.g., payment/v1/rules, payment/v2/payins/simulation, and a distinct 'Transfers v.3 API' that explicitly replaces the legacy Quote API), indicating real API versioning and a migration path. However, there is no explicit documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset dates, notice periods) — only a migration guide for one specific transition. Missing for 10: a formal deprecation/versioning policy page, sunset timelines for older API versions, and independent confirmation of adherence to such a policy.
